question_en: Which test is listed for three-phase motors?
explanation_en: Vibration is one of the tests listed in the RSOS range for three-phase motors.
explanation_es: La vibración es una de las pruebas listadas para motores trifásicos.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Installs fire alarm systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places E-26.01 under E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica E-26.01 dentro de E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Maintains fire alarm systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains renewable energy generating and energy storage systems
Installs and maintains HVAC electrical components
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places E-26.02 under E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica E-26.02 dentro de E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Installs security and surveillance systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains exit and emergency lighting systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places E-26.03 under E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica E-26.03 dentro de E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Maintains security and surveillance systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains motor starters and control devices
Installs and maintains building automation systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places E-26.04 under E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica E-26.04 dentro de E-26: Installs and maintains signalling systems.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Installs communication systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places E-27.01 under E-27: Installs and maintains communication systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica E-27.01 dentro de E-27: Installs and maintains communication systems.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Maintains communication systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains renewable energy generating and energy storage systems
Installs and maintains HVAC electrical components
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places E-27.02 under E-27: Installs and maintains communication systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica E-27.02 dentro de E-27: Installs and maintains communication systems.

question_en: After testing a building automation system, how should results be evaluated?
options: Against previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_en: E-28.02 explicitly requires those references for evaluating test results.
explanation_es: E-28.02 exige esas referencias para evaluar resultados.

question_en: A building automation component is being replaced. Which coordination is specifically required?
options: Coordinate replacement with the facility and local monitoring station, then test and verify.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires scheduling replacement with facility/local monitoring station and testing/verifying the replacement.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige coordinar con la instalación/estación de monitoreo y probar/verificar el reemplazo.

question_en: Which component is listed for building automation systems?
explanation_en: PoE switches are included among building automation system components.
explanation_es: Los switches PoE están incluidos entre los componentes de automatización de edificios.

question_en: What should be recorded when an analog I/O device is calibrated?
explanation_en: The RSOS requires documenting as-found/as-left when calibrating analog I/O devices.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige documentar as-found/as-left al calibrar dispositivos I/O analógicos.

question_en: An analog input signal is unstable. Which maintenance action is specifically identified in the RSOS?
options: Review and analyze signal trends to verify integrity.
explanation_en: F-29.04 requires reviewing and analyzing input-signal trends to verify signal integrity.
explanation_es: F-29.04 exige revisar y analizar tendencias de la señal para verificar su integridad.

question_en: Which is listed as an analog input device?
explanation_en: Pressure transmitters are listed among analog input devices.
explanation_es: Los transmisores de presión están listados como dispositivos de entrada analógica.

question_en: Which is listed as an analog output device?
explanation_en: Proportional valves are listed among analog output devices.
explanation_es: Las válvulas proporcionales están listadas como dispositivos de salida analógica.

question_en: Before installing an analog I/O device, what should a visual inspection confirm?
options: No damage and nameplate data matches drawings.
Only that the enclosure is new.
That the controller is in RUN.
explanation_en: F-29.03 requires checking for damage and confirming nameplate data matches drawings.
explanation_es: F-29.03 exige revisar daños y confirmar que la placa coincida con los planos.

question_en: How is polarity to field devices ensured according to the RSOS?
options: Using a multimeter, plans and applicable information.
Polarity is irrelevant for analog devices.
explanation_en: The RSOS specifically calls for ensuring polarity using a multimeter and plans.
explanation_es: El RSOS indica asegurar polaridad usando multímetro y planos.

question_en: After servicing an analog I/O device, what must be verified?
explanation_en: F-29.04 requires verification of operation following service according to process parameters.
explanation_es: F-29.04 exige verificar la operación después del servicio según parámetros de proceso.

question_en: Which condition is included in sensory inspection of analog I/O components?
explanation_en: Loose connections are among the defects/conditions identified in the RSOS range.
explanation_es: Las conexiones flojas aparecen entre las condiciones/defectos del rango del RSOS.

question_en: When programming an automated control system, what is done before setting internal address variables?
explanation_en: F-30.03 lists mapping inputs/outputs before setting address variables in its programming performance criteria.
explanation_es: F-30.03 lista mapear entradas/salidas antes de establecer variables de dirección.

question_en: After editing an automated-control program, what must be done with program changes?
options: Back them up and document them according to facility policy.
Keep them only in temporary memory.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires program changes to be backed up and documented.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige respaldar y documentar los cambios del programa.

question_en: Which item is listed as a program variable?
explanation_en: Counters are listed among automated-control program variables.
explanation_es: Los contadores están listados entre las variables de programas de control automatizado.

question_en: Which control logic format is explicitly listed in the RSOS?
explanation_en: Ladder logic is listed in the RSOS control-circuit logic range.
explanation_es: Ladder logic está listada en el rango de lógica de control del RSOS.

question_en: Which data communication system is listed for automated control systems?
explanation_en: Modbus is one of the listed automated-control data communication systems.
explanation_es: Modbus es uno de los sistemas de comunicación listados.

question_en: A PLC program has been modified to meet new process logic. What should occur before the work is considered complete?
options: Verify the program operates to specified logic, back it up, document changes, and test/adjust.
explanation_en: F-30.03 requires verification, backup/documentation and testing/adjustment of the program.
explanation_es: F-30.03 exige verificación, respaldo/documentación y prueba/ajuste del programa.

question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Installs pneumatic control systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains pneumatic and hydraulic control systems
Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places F-31.01 under F-31: Installs and maintains pneumatic and hydraulic control systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica F-31.01 dentro de F-31: Installs and maintains pneumatic and hydraulic control systems.
